items.title: Automattic loses its interim CFO just weeks after boardroom shakeup
items.summary: Automattic's interim chief financial officer Jeremy Klaperman has left the company less than a month after taking the role, TechCrunch has learned. Sources say his departure followed a demotion back to his previous position, marking another executive exit amid the organization's leadership turmoil.
items.creator: Sarah Perez
